skill.summary: 基于任务类型动态调度到合适的智能体角色（架构师、产品经理、测试专家、独立开发者）。支持多智能体协作、共识机制和完整项目生命周期管理。支持中英文双语。

latestVersion.changelog: 基于任务类型动态调度到合适的智能体角色（架构师、产品经理、测试专家、独立开发者）。支持多智能体协作、共识机制和完整项目生命周期管理。支持中英文双语。Dynamically dispatches to appropriate agent roles (Architect, Product Manager, Test Expert, Solo Coder) based on task type. Supports multi-agent collaboration, consensus mechanism, complete project lifecycle management, specification-driven development, code map generation, and project understanding. Supports Chinese-English bilingual.
